execution_requires: Independent fine joint witness, then freeze W_CONTROLLED_PRIOR before any new observation. Original undefined minimum_feature is not retroactively PASS.
direct_adaptive_control: Before fresh observation generation, add full3 plus directly integrated truncated order3 CDF control. Compare with5/9 under identical tolerances and cache rights. This strengthens the ordinary direct baseline; it does not alter the reference gate or any prior.
reference: Direct full-Maxwell positive quadrature with one proper shared complex gain marginalized once. Independent order and truncated-CDF checks. Numerical empirical reliability, not general continuous PDE certification.
compression: Separate branch-specific tensor response interpolation; retain branch priors and target conditional dependence. Compare direct adaptive quadrature with equal cache rights, including setup, validation and all fallback.

finite_material_rule.purpose: Branch-specific full9 response interpolation, followed by normalized finite quadrature and independent continuous-CDF validation on EACH new observation. This rule does not change the continuous prior.

point_full_validation.failure_fallback: Global shared-gain profile over the paid full9 material nodes; record the approximation failure and all attempted costs. No truth-dependent fallback.

scoring.replicas: average two noise replicas within each parent
secondary: all setup, correction and validation costs

P1B.posterior_position_mean: Bayes action for position loss within the controlled prior; may lie between disconnected position intervals and is not a new physical world.
P1B.correctness: Finite quadrature prior target independently checked against continuous quadrature reference; no claim to unrestricted wall posterior. Correct MH with proposal ratio, repeated states retained.

truth_use: Generation and separate offline scoring only; online quadrature/proposal code reads observation-only file.
stopping: Unqualified reference cannot support calibrated P1-B claims; retain failures and independent numerical diagnostics. No extra stage budget.
